(()=>{cleaning.setView('iso');cleaning.seek(0);if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth)throw Error('Page overflow');const bad=[...document.querySelectorAll('.steps button,.readouts b,.zone,.toolbar,header')].filter(e=>e.scrollWidth>e.clientWidth+1);if(bad.length)throw Error('Text overflow '+bad.map(e=>e.textContent).join('|'));JSON.stringify({t:0,step:document.getElementById('stepTitle').textContent,status:document.getElementById('cleanState').textContent})})()
